issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Specsight
products.tagline: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI
products.summaryZh: 为快速交付AI产品的团队提供产品可观测性
products.descriptionZh: 用AI快速交付？Specsight将代码变更转化为动态产品地图、功能知识和清晰的发布更新。让产品、销售和支持团队与软件的实际功能及变更保持同步。
products.description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

products.name: SKI
products.tagline: Voice-first coding harness
products.summaryZh: 语音优先的编码框架
products.descriptionZh: 与你的编程智能体对话，听它们回应。SKI 在你的 Mac 上并行运行 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、Antigravity 和 pi，并在其中一个需要你时立即通知你。
products.description: Talk to your coding agents and hear them talk back. SKI runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity and pi side by side on your Mac, and tells you the moment one needs you.

products.name: telemetry.dev
products.tagline: LLM observability for AI agents
products.summaryZh: AI代理的LLM可观测性
products.descriptionZh: telemetry.dev 将 AI 代理的每次运行显示为一条 trace。每次模型调用和工具调用都是一个 span，包含其持续时间、token、成本和错误。提示词和评估使用相同的 trace：无需部署即可更改提示词，然后在数据集上运行，并将分数与生产环境比较。告警会通知你错误、成本激增和代理循环。可通过我们的 TypeScript 或 Python SDK 连接，或使用你已在用的 OpenTelemetry 导出器。
products.description: telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

products.name: Backenly
products.tagline: The autonomous backend for AI coding agents
products.summaryZh: AI编码代理的自主后端
products.descriptionZh: Backenly 是一个为编码代理构建的自主后端平台。你的代理通过 MCP 构建后端，涵盖从 Postgres 到登录、存储、函数和实时功能。随后它自行维护：每分钟运行一次自愈循环，修复缺失的索引、RLS 漏洞和失效的实时触发器，并实时验证每项修复。随着应用增长，它会在你批准后重构自身的 schema。有风险的变更会等待你确认，每项变更都带版本记录并支持回滚。
products.description: Backenly is an autonomous backend platform built for coding agents. Your agent builds the backend over MCP, from Postgres to sign-in, storage, functions and realtime. Then it maintains itself: every minute a self-healing loop repairs missing indexes, RLS gaps and dead realtime triggers, verifying each fix live. As your app grows, it restructures its own schema once you approve. Risky changes wait for you, and every change is versioned with rollback.

products.name: WinnerAdSpy
products.tagline: Turn competitor ad insights into winning app campaigns
products.summaryZh: 将竞争对手的广告洞察转化为制胜的应用推广活动
products.descriptionZh: Winneradspy 是专为移动应用和游戏营销人员打造的广告创意情报平台。探索覆盖 20 万+ 应用的 2000 万+ 广告创意，发掘制胜钩子、视觉、信息传达与 CTA，并通过实时提醒追踪竞品广告活动。与通用广告监测工具不同，它将创意评分为 Winner、Loser 或 Learning，帮助 UA 经理、增长团队和代理机构理解哪些有效并打造更优广告活动。通过 MCP 在 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Gemini 中查询广告洞察。
products.description: Winneradspy is an ad creative intelligence platform built specifically for mobile app and game marketers. Explore 20M+ ad creatives across 200K+ apps, uncover winning hooks, visuals, messaging and CTAs, and track competitor campaigns with real-time alerts. Unlike generic ad spy tools, it scores creatives as Winner, Loser or Learning, helping UA managers, growth teams and agencies understand what works and build better campaigns. Query ad insights through ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini via MCP.

products.name: LumaFold: Screen Light
products.tagline: Makeup Mirror & Color Effects for iPhone Duo
products.summaryZh: iPhone Duo 化妆镜与色彩效果
products.descriptionZh: 让 iPhone Duo 屏幕化身创意工作室，配备可调节屏幕灯光、实时化妆镜、色彩动画和个性化照片展示。LumaFold 让你以不同方式使用两块屏幕区域。一边为面部补光，一边检查妆容；搭配两种颜色拍出创意照片；或将喜爱的照片与手写留言组合在一起。为你的美妆流程提供光线：一侧使用实时相机镜，另一侧使用可调节灯光。
products.description: Make your iPhone Duo screen a creative studio with adjustable screen lighting, a live makeup mirror, color animations, and personal photo displays. LumaFold lets you use two screen areas differently. Light your face while checking your makeup, pair two colors for a creative shot, or combine a favorite photo with a handwritten message. LIGHT FOR YOUR BEAUTY ROUTINE Use the live camera mirror on one side and adjustable light on the other.

products.name: Secret Key
products.tagline: Let your family unlock your passwords if you can't
products.summaryZh: 如果你无法解锁密码，可以让家人帮你解锁。
products.descriptionZh: 开源、自托管的密码数据库紧急访问功能。将主密码拆分成多份，交给您信任的人（例如5人中任意3人即可解锁）。访问需要短信验证，并有48小时延迟，您可一键取消。
products.description: Open-source, self-hosted emergency access for your password database. Split the master password into pieces for people you trust (e.g. any 3 of 5 unlock it). Access needs SMS verification and a 48-hour delay you can cancel with one click.

products.name: Knucklebop
products.tagline: tap your palm rest to control your Mac
products.summaryZh: 轻拍掌托即可控制你的 Mac
products.descriptionZh: 轻点两下可在任何会议中静音麦克风。轻点三下播放音乐。轻点四下打开任意菜单。
products.description: Tap twice to mute your mic in any meeting. Three times to play music. Four for a menu of anything.

products.name: GitHub Copilot Fusion
products.tagline: GitHub's AI coding agent that picks and combines models
products.summaryZh: GitHub 的 AI 编程代理，可挑选并组合模型
products.descriptionZh: GitHub Copilot Fusion 让选择编码 AI 模型不再靠猜。它无需挑选单一模型，而是自动将每项任务路由到合适的模型，并在需要时将它们组合起来。一个模型可以编写代码，另一个模型则负责审查或改进。可选择 Standard、High 或 Max 努力级别，以平衡速度、质量和成本。该功能已在 VS Code、Copilot CLI、Copilot 应用和 JetBrains IDE 的 GitHub Copilot 各计划中提供。
products.description: GitHub Copilot Fusion takes the guesswork out of choosing AI models for coding. Instead of picking one model, Fusion automatically routes each task to suitable models and combines them when needed. One model can write code while another reviews or improves it. Choose Standard, High, or Max effort to balance speed, quality, and cost. Available across GitHub Copilot plans in VS Code, Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and JetBrains IDEs.

products.name: BaseTab AI
products.tagline: Turn your new tab into an AI-powered workspace
products.summaryZh: 将你的新标签页变成AI驱动的工作空间
products.descriptionZh: BaseTab 将浏览器空白的新标签页变成可自行布置的仪表盘。拖入 30 多种小组件：笔记、待办、看板、番茄钟、书签、天气、Google Calendar、Gmail，以及与 Claude、ChatGPT 或 Gemini 聊天。缺少某个小组件？用自然语言描述，AI 会为你构建。为工作和生活保留独立的工作区，与团队共享一个工作区，并选择像家一样的背景。永久免费，无需账户即可使用，仅在小组件需要时才请求网站访问权限。
products.description: BaseTab turns your browser's empty new tab into a dashboard you arrange yourself. Drag in 30+ widgets: notes, to-dos, Kanban, Pomodoro, bookmarks, weather, Google Calendar, Gmail, and chat with Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Missing a widget? Describe it in plain words and AI builds it for you. Keep separate workspaces for work and life, share one with your team, and pick a background that feels like home. Free forever, works without an account, and asks for site access only when a widget needs it.

products.name: Coding Wrapped
products.tagline: See how you really vibe code with Claude Code & Codex
products.summaryZh: 看看你如何真正用 Claude Code 和 Codex 进行 vibe code。
products.descriptionZh: 你的 agent 记得每一次会话，你却不记得。Coding Wrapped 把你本地的 Claude Code 和 Codex 历史变成像素风年度总结：你的节奏、你反复说的那些话（“continue”，有人吗？）、agent 悄悄接手了什么，以及针对每个习惯的一条小建议。开源，一条命令，100% 本地。
products.description: Your agent remembers every session. You don't. Coding Wrapped turns your local Claude Code & Codex history into a pixel-art Wrapped: your rhythm, the words you repeat ("continue", anyone?), what the agent quietly took over, and one small tip for each habit. Open source, one command, 100% local.

products.name: Hemmed
products.tagline: Hide Mac menu bar clutter and pin individual actions
products.summaryZh: 隐藏 Mac 菜单栏杂乱内容，并固定单个操作
products.descriptionZh: 原生 macOS 应用，可将菜单栏图标隐藏在一个项目之后，拯救卡在刘海后面的图标，把菜单命令固定到快捷键，让新菜单栏应用保持隐藏，标记耗电的隐藏应用，并通过 iCloud 在你的多台 Mac 之间同步布局。
products.description: Native macOS app that hides menu bar icons behind one item, rescues icons stuck behind the notch, pins menu commands to hotkeys, keeps new menu bar apps hidden, flags battery-hungry hidden apps, and syncs your layout across your Macs with iCloud.

products.name: Godwit
products.tagline: An open-source, AI-native email client
products.summaryZh: 一个开源、AI原生的电子邮件客户端
products.descriptionZh: Godwit 是一款开源桌面电子邮件客户端，适用于任何 IMAP/SMTP 账户，内置 AI 助手 Wit，可使用你选择的模型读取、总结、翻译和起草邮件。
products.description: Godwit is an open-source desktop email client for any IMAP/SMTP account, with an AI assistant, Wit, that reads, summarizes, translates and drafts mail with the model you choose.

products.name: AC Bridge
products.tagline: Your smart lights show when Claude Code or Codex needs you.
products.summaryZh: 你的智能灯会在 Claude Code 或 Codex 需要你时亮起提示。
products.descriptionZh: AC Bridge 可将你已有的智能灯和智能插座变为 Claude Code 与 Codex 的环境状态指示。一眼即可看出你的智能体是在工作、受阻还是已完成，并让 Claude Code 或 Codex 在任务步骤中驱动你已连接的设备。兼容 Hue、Govee、WLED、LIFX、Nanoleaf 等，以及 Home Assistant。
products.description: AC Bridge turns the smart lights and plugs you already own into ambient status for Claude Code and Codex. See at a glance whether your agent is working, blocked or done, and let Claude Code or Codex drive the devices you have connected, as a step in a task. Works with Hue, Govee, WLED, LIFX, Nanoleaf and more, plus Home Assistant.

products.name: Mo
products.tagline: A little character on your Mac who does 232 tasks for you
products.summaryZh: Mac 上的一个小角色，为你完成 232 项任务
products.descriptionZh: Mo 住在你的 Mac 屏幕上，替你完成工作：文件、PDF、照片、电子邮件、日历、设置、日常事务等，无需其他应用即可处理 232 项任务。说话或打字，以卡片形式获取答案，任何操作都可撤销。隐私保护，可使用本地模型或你自己的密钥。一次性付费 $19.99。
products.description: Mo lives on your Mac screen and does the work for you: files, PDFs, photos, email, calendar, settings, routines and more, 232 tasks with no other app. Talk or type, get answers as cards, undo anything. Private, local models or your key. $19.99 once.

products.name: Seqora
products.tagline: Design your schema on a canvas. Seqora writes the SQL.
products.summaryZh: 在画布上设计你的模式。Seqora 编写 SQL。
products.descriptionZh: 一款适用于 PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB 和 SQLite 的桌面数据库客户端。在 ER 画布上修改表，Seqora 会生成 SQL。每个索引、约束、触发器和函数都有独立页面，显示大小、使用情况和健康状况。可视化 EXPLAIN 按步骤展示执行计划，并附实测耗时。支持 macOS 和 Windows，无需账号。
products.description: A desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite. Change tables on an ER canvas and Seqora writes the SQL. Every index, constraint, trigger and function gets its own page with size, usage and health. Visual EXPLAIN shows the plan step by step with measured timings. macOS and Windows, no account.

products.name: Agnos
products.tagline: Clean documents for AI, and see what was removed
products.summaryZh: 为AI清理文档，并查看移除了哪些内容
products.descriptionZh: Agnos 会在 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint 和网页内容进入 AI 聊天机器人、RAG 知识库或训练数据之前对其进行清理。它会移除重复的页眉页脚、页码、Cookie 横幅、模板化文本和重复内容，并保留表格、代码和数字。每一项移除都会标明所依据的规则；你可以保留某部分内容，或关闭对应规则。可导出 JSONL 分块、清理后的文本或训练数据。在你的 Windows PC 上运行；不会上传任何内容。来自 Microsoft Store：免费使用 14 天，之后一次性支付 99 美元。
products.description: Agnos cleans PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and web pages before they go into an AI chatbot, a RAG knowledge base or training data. It removes repeated headers and footers, page numbers, cookie banners, boilerplate and duplicates, and keeps tables, code and numbers. It names the rule behind every removal; keep a piece or switch its rule off. Exports JSONL chunks, cleaned text or training data. Runs on your Windows PC; nothing is uploaded. From the Microsoft Store: 14 days free, then $99 once.

products.name: Pluto Door
products.tagline: SSH client with an AI agent and a desktop for every server
products.summaryZh: 带AI代理的SSH客户端，每台服务器配有桌面
products.descriptionZh: 本次发布新增 Ori，一个 AI 代理，它能读取你的服务器、发现问题并用通俗英语解释。当需要做出更改时，你会先看到每一条命令，未经你批准不会执行任何操作；每个被编辑的文件都可以撤销。Pluto XOS 将每台服务器变成带有 15 个应用的桌面，Hangar 一键安装软件，定时检查会在小问题变大之前通知你。支持 AWS、Google Cloud 和 Azure。你的服务器和密钥保留在你的 Mac 上。免费使用 14 天。
products.description: This launch adds Ori, an AI agent that reads your servers, finds what's wrong and explains it in plain English. When something needs to change, you see every command first and nothing runs until you approve; every edited file can be undone. Pluto XOS turns each server into a desktop with 15 apps, Hangar installs software in one click, and scheduled checks notify you before small problems grow. Works with AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Your servers and keys stay on your Mac. Free for 14 days.

products.name: Genjutsu AI
products.tagline: Swap characters, outfits or backgrounds and keep the motion
products.summaryZh: 交换角色、服装或背景，同时保留动作。
products.descriptionZh: Genjutsu AI 可编辑你已有的视频。上传一段片段，添加最多九张参考图，并描述要进行的更改，以替换角色、服装、产品或背景，或对整个镜头重新风格化，同时原始运动、镜头运动和时序保持不变。可选择 Seedance 2.5、Seedance 2.0 或 MiniMax H3，时长 5 至 30 秒，分辨率 480p 至 1080p，并下载保留源音频的 MP4。独立工具，与 Higgsfield 无关联。
products.description: Genjutsu AI edits a video you already have. Upload a clip, add up to nine reference images and describe the change to replace a character, outfit, product or background, or restyle the whole shot, while the original motion, camera movement and timing stay in place. Choose Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0 or MiniMax H3, 5 to 30 seconds and 480p to 1080p, and download an MP4 that keeps the source audio. Independent tool, not affiliated with Higgsfield.

products.name: ChainPoints
products.tagline: Flight Prices in Your Points, on Google Flights
products.summaryZh: 用你的积分查看航班价格，尽在 Google Flights
products.descriptionZh: ChainPoints 是一款免费的 Chrome 扩展程序，可在 Google Flights 票价页面实时显示使用信用卡积分预订航班的最省钱方式。
products.description: ChainPoints is a free Chrome extension that shows you the cheapest way to book flights with your credit card points, live on Google Flights fare.
